title: MayarsDiamondPack
description: Replaces the boring old vanilla diamond tools with custom, high-quality models for the sword, pickaxe, and axe.
body:
3D Diamond Tools v1.0.0
Added
Custom 3D Diamond Pickaxe
Custom 3D Diamond Axe
Custom 3D Diamond Sword
Features
High-quality 3D models
Vanilla-friendly design
Optimized for survival gameplay
Notes
The resource pack may appear as "Incompatible" in Minecraft's resource pack menu.
This is expected and the pack should still work correctly in supported versions.
First public release.
